text:
jen: heads-up — noticed a weird divergence between invoice-preview and final ledger for a small set of tenants in EU-west. preview shows duplicate token counts for some sessions.

david: duplicate how? same session counted twice or different session_ids?

jen: same session_id but two preview events ~1s apart with slightly different client_id. finalizer collapses them correctly, preview doesn't.

metering-bot: flagged 42 preview duplicates (session_id collisions with differing client_id) between 1839991000..1839991200 in eu-west.

maya: can you paste an obfuscated sample?

jen: sample (redacted):
```
session: s_XYZ, ts: 1839991123, client_id: cid-7a, tokens: 210
session: s_XYZ, ts: 1839991124, client_id: cid-7b, tokens: 210
```

jen: final ledger shows a single entry for s_XYZ tokens=210 and resolution_id present. preview shows both entries, summing to 420.

alan: hmm — reminds me of the edge-proxy change that rewrites client_id for rotating keys. did we recently roll proxy that adds short-lived client_id variants?

clare: yes we rolled proxy-auth v1.4 last night (client rotation to support token-less refresh). it emits both original client_id and a rotated_client_id in the header for a brief overlap window.

david: finalizer has a dedupe step keyed by session_id + canonical_client_id (it normalizes rotated ids). preview consumer uses a cheaper key (session_id + raw client_id) for performance and missed normalization.

metering-bot: correlating deploys: proxy-auth v1.4 rolled eu-west at 1839990900, preview-consumer config unchanged.

maya: support impact? are customers billed twice?

billing-bot: final invoices unaffected. only preview display inflated. no invoice events created twice in billing ledger.

jen: CS reported 2 tickets where customers saw preview double token counts and worried about unexpected charges.

alan: actionable fixes: short-term: update preview-consumer to apply the same client_id canonicalization as finalizer (cheap normalization function). mid-term: unify dedupe logic or tag rotated ids in ingest so preview can cheaply consult.

david: UX quick-win: add a small confidence indicator on the preview card and a hover tooltip: "Preview may include transient duplicates when client rotation or rollout overlap occurs; final invoices are authoritative."

maya: I'll draft the support reply and include a reconcile query.

jen: reconcile SQL for CS: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) as preview_tokens FROM preview_events WHERE ts >= t0 GROUP BY session_id HAVING preview_tokens != (SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM final_ledger WHERE final_ledger.session_id = preview_events.session_id);`

clare: low-risk deploy plan: roll preview-consumer normalization as canary on one partition in eu-west, monitor preview_vs_final delta.

jen: starting canary deploy now (partition 4). sre: please watch.

sre-bot: deploy started -> preview-consumer-normalize-clientid.canary (eu-west partition-4) sha: b1c2d3.

jen: canary metrics: duplicates flagged dropped from 42 -> 1 in 7 minutes. preview_vs_final delta for the affected tenant set dropped from 2.7% -> 0.1%.

david: nice. I'll push the preview confidence banner behind flag and add a link to the reconcile docs.

maya: CS blurb draft: "Invoice Preview may temporarily over-count tokens for sessions when client_id rotation is in-flight. Final invoices are authoritative and unaffected. If you'd like us to reconcile specific preview ids, reply with the preview id and we will verify."

alan: long-term: prefer adding a canonical_client_id header at ingest so both preview and finalizer use identical keys; also add an `idempotency_parent` pointer in events to indicate canonicalization mapping.

clare: also add an alert rule: if preview shows >1% duplicate-sum in a region for 5m, page eng-platform oncall. exclude tagged deploy windows for 10m after a deploy event.

metering-bot: created ticket BILL-MET-4312 "preview duplicate tokens during client_id rotation" assigned to jen/alan/clare.

jen: canary stable at 28m; promoting normalization region-wide. will keep preview confidence banner for 24h and then reevaluate.

billing-bot: recorded: no billing corrections necessary.

david: follow-up: add unit test to preview-consumer that simulates rotated client_id pairs so we don't regress.

jen: will add tests + link to ticket. closing thread unless other objections. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: note: related deploy metadata stored in /deploys/proxy-auth/1.4/eu-west.json

clare: thanks all, will update the post-deploy notes.
